description: This file provides shell functions for managing network interfaces in OpenWRT, including configuration loading, interface fixing, scanning, and setup via ubus communication.

methods.name: find_config
methods.description: Finds network interface configuration matching a given device name.

methods.name: unbridge
methods.description: A placeholder function that currently does nothing.

methods.name: ubus_call
methods.description: Performs a ubus RPC call and processes the JSON response.

methods.name: fixup_interface
methods.description: Adjusts interface configuration, especially for bridge types, based on current status.

methods.name: scan_interfaces
methods.description: Loads network configuration and fixes up all interfaces.

methods.name: prepare_interface_bridge
methods.description: Prepares a network interface bridge by invoking ubus call.

methods.name: setup_interface
methods.description: Adds a device to a network interface.
